packageRules.description: Auto-merge patch updates of stable (non-0.x) dependencies
Patch updates -> fix(deps) so Release Please cuts a patch
Minor updates -> feat(deps) so Release Please cuts a minor
Major updates -> breaking feat(deps)! so Release Please cuts a major
A Python feature release (e.g. 3.13 -> 3.14) is breaking for us

GitHub Actions run in CI and never ship in the MSI, so they must not move the app version at all. Must stay LAST: the update-type rules above would otherwise make actions/checkout v6 -> v7 a breaking change to Varys.
